name: agent-qa
description: Explore apps and games, preserve evidence, reproduce findings and export QA reports.

interface.shortDescription: Explore, reproduce and report quality issues
interface.longDescription: Local-first QA evidence management and an optional browser adapter. Uses the coding client's model and existing app/game tools; no separate model key required. Install the agent-qa CLI before enabling MCP. External observations are explicitly operator-attested.
defaultPrompt: Explore this app for quality issues and produce an evidence-backed report.
